identificationModule.briefTitle: SI-B001 Combined With Osimertinib Mesylate Tablets in the Treatment of Recurrent Metastatic Non-small Cell Lung Cancer.
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II/III Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of SI-B001 in Combination With Osimertinib Mesylate Tablets in the Treatment of Recurrent and Metastatic Non- Small Cell Lung Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This multi-center, open label Phase II/III clinical study is performed in patients with locally advanced/metastatic NSCLC progressed on prior EGFR-TKI treatment or with non TKI-sensitizing mutation or patients with EGFR exon20ins mutation. This study is investigating the safety and efficacy of SI-B001 at monotherapy RP2D or lower combined with Osimertinib in patients with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC.

armGroups.label: SI-B001 combined with osimertinib_A
armGroups.description: Patients with locally advanced/metastatic NSCLC progressed on 3rd generation EGFR-TKI treatment.

armGroups.label: SI-B001 combined with osimertinib_B
armGroups.description: Patients with locally advanced/metastatic NSCLC progressed on prior EGFR-TKI treatment and with T790M negative mutation.

armGroups.label: SI-B001 combined with osimertinib_C
armGroups.description: Patients with locally advanced/metastatic NSCLC and with EGFR exon20ins mutation.

interventions.name: SI-B001
interventions.description: SI-B001 is administered by intravenous drip once weekly (QW). 120 min ± 10 min after the first intravenous drip, if the infusion reaction is tolerable during the first dose, the subsequent infusion can be completed within 60-120 min (unless agreed or required by the investigator, the infusion time can be extended).

interventions.name: Osimertinib
interventions.description: Osimertinib is administered at the recommended dose of 80mg daily.

primaryOutcomes.description: Optimal combination dose for SI-B001 and Osimertinib (only IIa)
